model_output.rationale: Line 1 (97140-GP-KX) denied CO-236 + N20 — NCCI PTP bundling against 97150. The chart note documents a separate session and distinct body region, which could support a bypass modifier if CCMI = 1. But the 835 carries neither the Column One partner code nor the CCMI indicator. Per reference 07-ncci-and-mue.md, the CCMI must be looked up in the PTP edit file for the DOS quarter before any action can be determined; guessing is prohibited.

awaiting_human.question: What is the CCMI (Column 2/Column 1 Modifier Indicator) for the 97140/97150 pair in the CMS NCCI PTP edit table effective Q3 2026 (July 1, 2026)?
awaiting_human.why_needed: CCMI = 1 → correct_and_resubmit with a bypass modifier (chart note documents separate session/distinct region). CCMI = 0 → do_not_resubmit, write off. CCMI = 9 → appeal edit applicability. The action is different in each case and cannot be determined without this value.
